General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is a Suzuki OEM Hood Stay Clamp that holds the hood stay in place when it is stowed away on all Geo Trackers and Suzuki Sidekicks.
By now your original hood stay clamp has gotten very brittle and most likely broken.
This new OEM clamp will pop right into the existing hole without any modifications and give you years of service.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Hood Stay Plastic Clip
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Geo Tracker 1989 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1998 All Models
